name: AI Conversation
description: The operator's entry point. Every question is answered over one fused cycle view rather than four reports that disagree.

name: Data Ingest
description: Billing system, rate-card and tax tables, account payment-method history and the usage-rating engine land in one cycle snapshot.

name: Rule Layer
description: Deterministic policy checks catch the unambiguous breaks — a discount that should have applied, a tax rate off its jurisdiction table.

name: ML Layer
description: Learned detection finds the breaks no rule was written for, and groups them into patterns by shared root cause.

name: LLM Edge Review
description: The residue the rules and the model both leave behind — the edge cases that fit no pattern and need a written explanation.

name: RCA
description: Root-cause analysis names the cause in plain language (a CGCM sync failure, a stale tax-rule version) instead of leaving a confidence score to speak for itself.

name: Human Review
description: The operator decides. Everything above this line is investigation; nothing reaches a customer's bill without a reviewed action here.

name: Rebilling API
description: Executes the approved corrections in bulk and returns a rebill ID per account, which is what makes the audit trail defensible.

name: BRN
description: The billing run number closes against the 36-hour SLA. Anything unresolved here becomes next cycle's credits and support calls.
